title: SkailrTelemetryEvent
description: One JSON object per line of .skailr/telemetry/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<emitter-id>.jsonl. Append-only, LF-terminated, UTF-8 no BOM, one compact object per line, max 64 KiB. Emitted by scripts/skailr/emit-telemetry.mjs around every subagent dispatch. Consumed by Skailr Console.
$comment: event_hash = "sha256:" + hex_lower(sha256(JCS(identity_subset))). identity_subset = {v, emit_seq, ts, event_type, trace_id, span_id, parent_span_id, hierarchy_path, agent_role, agent_name, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, status, corrects_event_hash}. JCS = RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme: keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit, no insignificant whitespace, numbers in shortest round-tripping form, null values included. Everything not in identity_subset (attrs, error, cost_usd, timestamps besides ts, repo/program/workstream/feature/ticket) is EXCLUDED from the hash — those fields are derivable, presentational, or correctable, and must not affect identity. In v1 all token fields are null and no non-integer numbers enter the subset, so JCS reduces to sorted keys + standard JSON string escaping + integer numbers, byte-identical to RFC 8785 for this subset.

v.description: Schema version. MUST be the literal integer 1.

event_hash.description: sha256:<hex_lower> over JCS(identity_subset). See $comment for the algorithm.

emit_seq.description: Monotonic per emitter process/file; 1 + max emit_seq in the active file, 0 if none.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC, ms precision, Z suffix. Event emission time.

duration_ms.description: Non-null iff end_ts non-null; MUST equal end_ts - start_ts in milliseconds.

event_type.description: v1 emits span.start and span.end only; other values reserved.

trace_id.description: ULID or UUIDv4. One per program/feature run.

span_id.description: ULID or UUIDv4. One per agent run/operation.

parent_span_id.description: Dispatching span's span_id. Null only for the root span of a trace.

hierarchy_path.description: Segments joined by /, each <level>:<slug>, fixed order portfolio→repo→program→workstream→feature→ticket→agent-run. No leading/trailing /. No intermediate level with a value may be skipped. slug charset [a-z0-9._-]+, lowercased, other chars → -, runs collapsed. portfolio:default is the no-portfolio sentinel.

repo.description: Nullable; MUST equal the repo: segment of hierarchy_path when both present.

program.description: Nullable; MUST equal the program: segment.

workstream.description: Nullable; MUST equal the workstream: segment.

feature.description: Nullable; MUST equal the feature: segment.

ticket.description: Nullable; declared case (e.g. "T-003"); the path segment is lowercased.

agent_role.description: Open vocab, lowercase kebab; unknown values are valid.

agent_name.description: Instance name; equals agent_role when unnamed.

tokens_in.description: Nullable; non-null iff event_type is "usage". Null in v1.

tokens_out.description: Nullable; non-null iff event_type is "usage". Null in v1.

cache_read_tokens.description: Nullable; non-null iff event_type is "usage". Null in v1.

cache_write_tokens.description: Nullable; non-null iff event_type is "usage". Null in v1.

cost_usd.description: Nullable, MAY be null and usually is — consumers never require it.

price_table_version.description: Nullable; set only when cost_usd is emitter-declared.

status.description: Terminal status carried on span.end (or the eventual span.end for blocked/over-budget).

error.description: Nullable object { code, message }; non-null iff status is error/timeout.

attrs.description: Flat map, ≤32 keys, ≤1 KiB serialized. Operational values only — MUST NOT contain prompt/response bodies.
